description_short: Cross-table query linking SiO2 ALE selectivity data (Table III) with chamber-wall treatment and etch rates (Table IV) for C4F8/Ar-based anisotropic processes.

paper.title: Atomic Layer Etching of SiO2 for Nanoscale Semiconductor Devices: A Review

tables_modeled.label: Table III
tables_modeled.description: SiO2 ALE selectivity data including selectivity pairs, ranges, and methods for improving selectivity.

tables_modeled.label: Table IV
tables_modeled.description: Chamber-wall treatment studies for SiO2 ALE, including wall-conditioning methods and resulting etch rates.

properties_used.label: Selectivity material pair
properties_used.role: Encodes the target selectivity pair (e.g., SiO2/Si, SiO2/Si3N4) from Table III.

properties_used.label: Selectivity value
properties_used.role: Selectivity magnitude or range for the SiO2 ALE process from Table III.

properties_used.label: Selectivity improvement method
properties_used.role: Describes how etch selectivity was improved in Table III (e.g., passivation or pulsing schemes).

properties_used.label: Precursor chemistries for fluorination
properties_used.role: Fluorocarbon precursor; used as part of the join key between Tables III and IV and to restrict to C4F8-based plasmas.

properties_used.label: Removal gas
properties_used.role: Removal / activation gas (e.g., Ar plasma); used both in the join and to enforce C4F8/Ar plasma systems.

properties_used.label: Chamber wall treatment method
properties_used.role: Describes the chamber-wall conditioning (none, O2 cleaning, wall heating) in Table IV.

properties_used.label: Etching rate
properties_used.role: Etch rate (Å/cycle) from Table IV, normalized to a numeric value to allow sorting.

aggregation.grouping_key: shared C4F8/Ar precursor + removal chemistry across Tables III and IV
aggregation.description: Rows are emitted for C4F8/Ar plasma conditions where the same precursor and removal gas appear in both the selectivity and chamber-wall comparisons.

output_shape.description: One row per matched C4F8/Ar SiO2 ALE process with joined selectivity and chamber-wall data.
columns: selectivity_pair: target selectivity material pair (e.g., SiO2/Si, SiO2/Si3N4).
selectivity: reported selectivity range or numerical value.
selectivity_method: method or strategy used to improve selectivity in Table III.
chamber_wall_treatment: chamber-wall treatment method (none, O2 cleaning, wall heating) from Table IV.
etch_rate: numeric etch rate derived from Table IV.

postprocessing_notes.interpretation: The result links SiO2 ALE selectivity metrics with chamber-wall conditioning and etch rates for C4F8/Ar plasma-based anisotropic processes, enabling comparison of how wall treatment strategies impact both selectivity and throughput.
